qualification.package: Clean public wheel from the tagged source, both unprivileged image imports reporting 0.14.0 and the 2720-pixel native-HD bound. Offline layers reuse the same immutable dependency images as 0.13.0, with no model payloads.
qualification.engine: Five complete 120-frame I2VA requests on one RTX 4090 (48 GiB reported memory) with BF16 hybrid Veda 44/6: 2720x1536 (two scenes), 1536x2720, 2368x1760 and 2720x1152, coherent without tiling or repeated structure. The last three used the unmodified release contract; numerical paths are unchanged from 0.13.0.
qualification.limits: Visual canvas qualification only, not sound quality or other GPUs. The 2048-squared area and joint pixel-frame budget are unchanged, so 4 MP canvases are five-second requests. Application capacity and lane declarations are separate.

native.name: hansimov/vflash:0.14.0
